name: Stage 20: Henaredalen to Malmköping
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 20, Henaredalen to Malmköping.
utilities: Västersjön shelter, toilet, fireplace/grill, tent space, swimming, and unknown-quality lake water sit at the stage-20 start/stage-19 boundary.

The reserve parking cannot currently be reached by car; use the road barrier shortly after Lisätter instead. OSM maps the lift gate around 59.1341325,16.7560548 and access from there is roughly 0.7 km to the stage mainline, but local signage should decide.

Malmköping is the service end: camping, bathing, toilets/showers, water refill, food, grocery, hotel/lodging, grill place, and bus access are the practical facilities. Camping-area services are on/near the trail; most town services are about 0.6-1 km away.
No regular train serves Malmköping. Use Malmköping busstation for public transport; Museispårvägen/Malmakvarn tram stops are seasonal heritage tram stops, not commute rail.
waterSources: No reliable natural drinking-water source was verified between Västersjön and Malmköping. Carry water or treat lake water in an emergency.
Västersjön/Mörtsjön are natural lake water only. Mörtsjön is a view/rest context, not a verified refill.

Malmköpings camping has the strongest endpoint water refill according to Sörmlandsleden/Visit Flen and mapped service data, but treat it as a facility with seasonal/opening-hour risk rather than a guaranteed always-on tap.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 6 km; Naturkartan, Visit Flen, AllTrails, and OSM also list 6.0 km, Naturkartan's current backing geometry is about 5.91 km, OSM relation 5447840 computes about 6.004 km, Äventyrligare lists 5.89 km, and local official-GPX-derived route geometry is about 5.79 km. Use 6 km as canonical.

Route character: starts at Västersjön/Henaredalen, passes through Henaredalen reserve, optional Skansberget fornborg/viewpoint branch above Henaren, Helvetets port, Mörtsjön, the Staven boundary cairn, varied conifer forest/bedrock and late-stage deciduous forest before Malmköping camping.

Henaredalen reserve rules are stricter than normal allemansrätten: no tenting, no fires, dogs/pets leashed year-round, no damaging trees/bushes, no picking flowers, no disturbing wildlife, no motor vehicles, and no littering.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass, but 2025 comments warn of fallen trees, missed turns, and difficult navigation on the optional Skansberget/fornborg loop. The stage maintainer says the small loop was re-marked in summer 2025 after bark-beetle/fallen-tree damage, but remains hard going; later 2025 comments describe the alternate as heavily blocked and potentially not passable.

The main route is generally short and service-friendly, but June 2025 comments still mention two difficult fallen-tree passages on the main direction toward Malmköping, and Vardagstur found grass/wetness after rain plus wet shoes/legs near Mörtsjön. Watch splits and old tracks where the trail changes direction.

Use the local shared GPX vertices as topology nodes for route-building: Stage 19/20 meet near 59.120929,16.799645 and Stage 20/21 meet near 59.139907,16.731912. OSM relation 5447840 shares Stage 19 at node 2418258366 near 59.1207390,16.8000930 and Stage 21 at node 3701770339 near 59.1392798,16.7318007; the official Malmköping coordinate is about 48 m away, so treat these as aliases rather than separate trailheads.

Skansberget/fornborg is an optional branch/alternate about 85 m off the local mainline, not the required Stage 20 mainline. Keep the mainline continuous and attach Skansberget as an optional side route with warnings; skip it in wind, heavy rain, low light, or with children, dogs, or large packs unless current conditions are confirmed.

If using OSM relation 5447840, do not trust raw member order as walking direction; assemble by shared endpoints for Henaredalen-to-Malmköping. Recommended OSM way order is 233436925 reversed, 233436922 reversed, 372184226 reversed, 366006656 reversed, 366006654 reversed, 372083671 forward, and 366192061 reversed.
Do not merge Lisätter access ways, the Skansberget optional loop, or Naturkartan's separate Led Henaredalen 1.4 km local route into the Stage 20 mainline. Present them as access/branch choices only.

Henaredalen-side transit is weak: no validated regular stop was verified within 2 km of the start, and Mortorp is a distant roughly 2.2 km straight-line fallback with sparse rural service. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken before planning around it.

Hosjöbadet/Malmköping local beach rules matter at the endpoint: no dogs on the main municipal beach, use the dog beach/access route with leash, no smoking, no fishing within the bathing area, and fires only at fixed municipal grill places when fire rules allow. 2025 bathing-water samples were acceptable and the 2026 season classification was excellent, but current seasonal advisories still need checking.

Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability, provides no shelter trash bins, and does not supply firewood. Carry out trash, bring water treatment/backup, and do not assume wood at Västersjön or Hosjöbadet.

facilities.name: Henaredalen / Västersjön stage start
facilities.description: Official stage-20 start coordinate near Västersjön and the stage-19 boundary.

facilities.name: Västersjön shelter
facilities.description: Substantial shelter just outside Henaredalen reserve at the stage start, with about 6 sleeping spots and Västersjön view.

facilities.name: Västersjön fire ring and grill
facilities.description: Fire ring a short distance from the shelter plus steel grill in front. Use only when current fire rules allow; the shelter/fireplace is just outside the reserve.

facilities.name: Västersjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet behind the shelter; separate OSM pin confirmed by official shelter/toilet context and hiker reports.

facilities.name: Västersjön tent/swim/lake-water context
facilities.description: Shelter source lists tent space, swimming, and water of unknown quality. Treat/filter any water and do not tent or make fires inside Henaredalen reserve.

facilities.name: Lisätter road-barrier parking
facilities.description: Practical access gate when the reserve parking is inaccessible. OSM maps this as a lift gate on the Lisätter access track; expect roughly 0.7 km to the Stage 20 mainline via access tracks, and verify current local signage before leaving a car.

facilities.name: Henaredalen reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rules: no tenting, no fires, dogs/pets leashed year-round, no damaging trees/bushes, no flower picking/digging, no disturbing wildlife/eggs/nests, no motor vehicles, and no littering. Dead spruce from bark-beetle damage can fall.

facilities.name: Skansberget fornborg viewpoint
facilities.description: Optional branch/viewpoint over Henaren. Official and Länsstyrelsen recommend it, but the ascent is more demanding than the valley route.

facilities.name: Skansberget loop fallen-tree/navigation warning
facilities.description: 2025 comments report fallen trees, unclear turns, and difficult passage on the optional fornborg loop; one September 2025 report described it as not passable due fallen trees. Maintainer says it was re-marked but remains difficult. Treat as optional and potentially slow/blocked.

facilities.name: Helvetets port
facilities.description: Approximate route marker for the old narrow passage between rock outcrops on the historical Dunker-Hyltinge road. Sources conflict between about 1 km and 2 km from the start; no precise official point coordinate was verified.

facilities.name: Mörtsjön rest/view context
facilities.description: Small tarn/rest context along the stage; route-line pass-by is nearer 59.1385,16.7751 while this marker uses the OSM lake centroid. Treat as natural/untested lake water only, not a practical drinking-water refill; expect wet grass or muddy footing after rain.

facilities.name: Staven boundary cairn
facilities.description: Large boundary cairn that was once a four-parish boundary point; official comment gives this coordinate.

facilities.name: Stage 20/21 OSM handoff
facilities.description: OSM graph boundary shared by Stage 20 relation 5447840 and Stage 21 relation 3854541. The official Malmköping start/end coordinate is about 48 m away, so use this for graph stitching and the camping/Hosjöbadet pins for facilities.

facilities.name: Malmköping camping water point
facilities.description: Mapped water point at the endpoint camping/service area; Sörmlandsleden and Visit Flen list water refill at Malmköping camping. Service or seasonal access may apply.

facilities.name: Malmköpings Bad & Camping services
facilities.description: Paid camping/service node with camping/cabins/hostel context, toilets/showers, cafe/kiosk/restaurant and beach-area services. Opening hours and seasonality vary.

facilities.name: Hosjöbadet toilets, grill, and beach
facilities.description: Bathing area by the camping with toilets/changing hut, kiosk, grill places, jetties, accessibility ramp and beach rules. Naturkartan and local rules note no smoking or dogs on the main beach; use the separate dog beach. Fishing is not allowed within the municipal bathing area.

facilities.name: Hosjön grill place
facilities.description: Two fireplaces by Hosjöbadet/Malmköpings Bad & Camping. Bring your own firewood or charcoal and use only fixed grill places when current fire rules allow; stricter fire bans can also close fixed grills.

facilities.name: Malmköping camping parking
facilities.description: Parking by Malmköpings Bad & Camping / Hosjöbadet at the stage end; check local signs and camping/seasonal rules.

facilities.name: Hemköp Malmköping Torget
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply about 0.8 km from the camping/stage end. Opening hours and services should be checked live.

facilities.name: Coop Malmköping
facilities.description: Additional town grocery/resupply option; opening hours and services should be checked live.

facilities.name: Hotel Malmköping / town lodging
facilities.description: Hotel/restaurant and lodging option off the route in town, about 0.6-1 km from the stage-end context depending on path.

facilities.name: Malmköping busstation
facilities.description: Practical public-transit end point about 0.7-1 km from the camping/stage end, with regional bus lines. No regular train; Museispårvägen/Malmakvarn tram stops are seasonal heritage tram, not dependable onward transport.

facilities.name: Mortorp weak Henaredalen-side bus context
facilities.description: Nearest mapped Henaredalen-side bus fallback found in this pass, but it is about 2.2 km straight-line from the trailhead with sparse rural service. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken before relying on it.

facilities.name: Fishing and bathing-area rule warning
facilities.description: Fishing is forbidden within Flens municipal bathing areas such as Hosjöbadet, and other lakes/waters normally require checking fishing rights or a fishing card. Do not present fishing as automatically allowed.
